name: display: grid
description: Turns an element into a grid container, enabling two-dimensional layout of its direct children into rows and columns.

name: grid-template-columns
description: Defines the number and size of the columns in a grid container.
notes: The fr unit distributes remaining free space proportionally between tracks.

name: grid-template-rows
description: Defines the number and size of the rows in a grid container.

name: grid-template-areas
description: Defines named grid areas as a visual ASCII-art-like map, which grid items can then be placed into by name.
notes: Each string represents a row; repeating a name spans that area across multiple cells.

name: grid-area
syntax: grid-area: name | row-start / column-start / row-end / column-end;
description: Assigns a grid item to a named area defined in grid-template-areas, or places it directly by line numbers.

name: grid-column
description: Shorthand for grid-column-start and grid-column-end, positioning and sizing an item across column lines.
notes: span keyword can be used instead of a line number, e.g. grid-column: span 2.

name: grid-row
description: Shorthand for grid-row-start and grid-row-end, positioning and sizing an item across row lines.

name: justify-items
description: Aligns grid items along the inline (row) axis within their grid cell, for all items in the container.

name: justify-self
description: Overrides justify-items for a single grid item, aligning it individually along the inline axis of its cell.

name: grid-auto-flow
description: Controls how auto-placed grid items (those without an explicit position) are inserted into the grid.
notes: dense fills earlier gaps in the grid, which can reorder items visually away from source order.

name: grid-auto-columns / grid-auto-rows
description: Sets the size of implicitly-created grid tracks that aren't defined in grid-template-columns/rows.

name: repeat()
description: Repeats a track size pattern a given number of times inside grid-template-columns/rows, avoiding manual repetition.
parameters: count — number of repetitions or auto-fill/auto-fit. track-size — the size to repeat.

name: minmax()
description: Defines a track size range, letting a track grow up to a max but never shrink below a min.
parameters: min — smallest allowed size. max — largest allowed size.

name: auto-fit vs auto-fill
description: Automatically determines how many tracks fit in the container; auto-fit collapses empty tracks to zero width while auto-fill preserves their space.
notes: auto-fit is usually what you want for responsive card grids that should stretch to fill the row.

name: place-items
description: Shorthand for setting align-items and justify-items together in a grid (or flex) container.
notes: A popular one-liner for centering a single child both horizontally and vertically.
